system: TITANOS site data files (sectors.json, proof.json), compiled by scripts/gen_open_data.mjs
licence: Free to use with attribution: cite titanos.tech and the compiled date. A formal open licence will be named here once the owner confirms it.

labels.MEASURED: Counted or timed on our own system, on the date shown.
labels.REPRODUCED: Measured, then repeated on a second run with the same result.
labels.MODELLED: Computed from measured inputs under stated assumptions. A scenario, not a result.
labels.ESTIMATE: A reasoned figure with a published method and a range.
labels.FORECAST: What we expect, with no result behind it yet.
labels.EXAMPLE: An illustration. Not a record of any real client.
labels.UNKNOWN: We have not measured this yet, so we do not show a number.

rows.caption: Build lanes finished on 2026-11-10, one full day (281 finished over 24 hours)
rows.label: MEASURED
rows.system: TitanOS build lanes (status record of every lane)
rows.method: Count lanes whose final status (done or failed) is stamped that day; lanes an hour = finished / 24; fail rate = failed / finished; median = latest start to finish, in minutes.
